# Goals of This Section

## Goals of This Section

In this section we will:

- Describe how technology changes the jobs we do
- Model capital-labour substitution with two and three factors
- Examine the evidence on skill-biased technological change and job polarization
- Discuss emerging technologies and their effect on labour demand
